decisions.reason: Cleaning soap is a commodity chemical product with high competition and low strategic fit, so its option value is unlikely to justify further investment.
Maintenance oil is a complementary consumable with higher margin potential, so we keep the option open while its prospects remain uncertain.
This care product overlaps with the maintenance oil and shows no distinct advantage, making the option likely to be abandoned to free resources.
Moisture-protection underlay can be bundled with flooring sales and has low keeping costs, so we keep the option open.
High-density underlay foam is a low-cost complementary option with unresolved prospects, so we keep it for now.
Oak parquet floor is core to our business and has high strategic option value, so we keep it.
